Need for Speed Underground / VLC parity pass

Original: The Skins Factory / Electronic Arts (2003).
VLC conversion: Dead Signal Interactive.

Install VLC, extract this bundle, then run Preview-1x.cmd or Preview-2x.cmd.
The launchers use separate settings files. 1x matches the source 300x298 size.
2x is 600x596 with independently resampled sprite frames. Its full-quality
animations can take about two minutes to cold-load; 1x is much quicker.

For your regular VLC profile: Tools > Preferences > Interface > Use custom
skin, choose a VLT, save and restart VLC.

Clock toggles elapsed/remaining. Color cycles seven palettes. The star opens
the video panel. List/bars open playlist/EQ. Information opens the original
menu; its footer includes conversion credits.

Read PARITY.md and VERIFICATION.md for supported behavior and pending checks.
This bundle is ready for hands-on review; 100% acceptance is not yet certified.
